question: What claim is made about the speaker's intention to disclose the method of names to the beautiful-eyed one?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names for them.
The addressee is urged to hear.
The disclosure is addressed to the beautiful-eyed one.
inference: The speaker will declare the method of their names; the beautiful-eyed one is urged to hear it.
uncertainties: The identity of 'them' is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear it, O beautiful-eyed one.
